what: 1100 arrows (＞) (800 below width 1200, 480 below 768) form shapes chosen per section on the single fixed canvas of the page — large English letters, a sphere, a browser window, a laptop and a phone ·</>…stacked chevrons·checks·covers·portraits·a three-ring loop circling the photo frame·three obliquely overlapping plates·a different picture per card — the birds gather into these shapes, and when scroll moves to the next section each bird, delayed by 0~.35 (over a .65 share, cubic inOut), moves from the previous shape to the next. While moving, the flock swells in depth and sideways by sin(π·progress) × .18 (phone .08) and then gathers again. With a camera depth 5 perspective, near birds look bigger and thicker (lines .95·1.35·2·3.4px). Birds track their target exponentially at a rate of 6~12 per second, turn their heads toward the direction of travel at 7 per second, open and close their wings at a .016 tempo, and sway slightly in place. Birds not used by a shape perch outside both screen sides. Birds within 110px of the cursor step aside up to 40px by distance, and nothing is drawn over text·buttons·photos (outer 6px). For the first 3 seconds they slowly fly in from an off-screen ring and land. When turning the page, sending fx:flock-gather makes the flock gather into an ellipse cloud at the screen center (short side 30%) and circle, and the next page starts from that cloud

options.form: word (default, large Latin letters) · sphere · monitor · devices · code(</>) · launch · logo · check · arrow · portrait · ring · stack · cards · bag · lock · windows · circle · brace · chevron · grid · cart · disc
options.text: Text for word·code — if absent, the child [data-fx-part=word] text
options.lead: Number of leading characters in word painted in the accent color, default 1
options.anchor: Reference box to place the shape (css selector) — if none, child [data-fx-part=stage], and if that is missing, the element itself
options.ax: Horizontal position within the reference box (0~1), default .5
options.ay: Vertical position within the reference box (0~1), default .5
options.fit: Shape Radius = Reference box width × fit (default per shape: cover 1/2.7, check 1/2.3, portrait 1/2.7, others .15)
options.max: Keep the radius from exceeding screen height × max
options.size: Bird size (px). Default is radius × .03 (4.5~8.5), word is radius × .0055 (4~6.5) · phone 3.4
options.count: New numbers this shape uses — default 600 (phone 240) · cover 104 (56) · check 64 (34) · ring 190 (64) · portrait 2200 (900) · whole card 720 (360)
options.rot: Amount of rotation around the vertical axis while passing a section (radians) — 0 at section center
options.glow: When on, adds a round glow in the accent color behind the shape (radius × 1.2, opacity .5)
options.flap: When on, the shape waves up and down like flapping wings
options.wave: Height of the horizontal wave in the shape
options.span: If on, when this section is taller than the screen, holds the shape for the whole section (for long sections like a case list)
options.key: center (default, the stop is when the section center is at screen center) · top (when the section top reaches 25% from the top of the screen)
options.<Key>-m: Values to use below width 1200 — ax-m·ay-m·fit-m·size-m …
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: ring — box that circles around. [data-on=true] only those inside, or the first if none
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: stack — one line per plate. The plate of the line under the pointer (or, if none, the line nearest screen center) rises and gets data-on=true
options.[data-fx-part=card]: cards — card picture slot. data-shape takes the picture name (bag·lock·windows·circle·brace·chevron·grid·cart·monitor·devices·check·logo·sphere·launch·arrow). If the card background differs from the band, use data-ink="dark|light"(new colors --fx-flock-dark · --fx-flock-light), data-lead="dark|light"(New accent color)
options.[data-flock-free]: Also draws a bird over the text and photos inside this (the spot where a bird perches on a picture, like a portrait)
options.fx:flock-gather: Sent to document, they gather into a cloud at the center (before the .55s page turn) · released by fx:flock-release
options.--fx-flock-ink · --fx-flock-lead: Bird colors — defaults --kf-ink · --kf-accent. For pages where the background changes per section, swap these two on html

use: STUDIO

from.where: shared.css · each page’s [data-fx~=arrow-flock] — original FlockProvider (1100-bird canvas, station key·hold, camera 5, cursor 110px·40px, center cloud .55s on transition)

note: In the original, when a section’s background color changes, the new color also becomes that section’s text color. The part reads --fx-flock-ink/lead every frame and follows. The original portrait is dot data extracted from a photo and is not used. A head-and-shoulders silhouette is drawn and sampled instead. The dotted lines joining plate corners in the original three-plate (stack) were not carried over.
